title: Beau Lamarre-Condon tells double murder trial firing first shot at Jesse Baird’s shoulder was ‘the right move’
summary_full: Former NSW police officer gives evidence for a second day after pleading not guilty to murdering Baird and Luke Davies in early 2024The day in court: Prosecution begins cross-examination of double murder accused Beau Lamarre-Condon Beau Lamarre-Condon “stands by” his decision to shoot Jesse Baird but did not intend to kill him, the New South Wales supreme court has heard.The former police officer is accused of fatally shooting Baird and his partner, Luke Davies, with his police service weapon in Baird’s Paddington home in Sydney on 19 February 2024.
